metadata.title: IDLOGICE — Canada Immigration Platform
metadata.description: Free CRS calculator, immigration evaluation, IELTS mock tests, and coaching. Your path to Canada starts here.

footer.disclaimer: IDLOGICE provides immigration information and tools for educational purposes only. We are not licensed immigration consultants or lawyers. Our tools provide estimates based on publicly available criteria and may not reflect your exact situation. For official immigration advice, consult a Regulated Canadian Immigration Consultant (RCIC) or a licensed immigration lawyer. Immigration rules change frequently — always verify current requirements with IRCC.
